About "Whiteout Tools Lab"

This site is a free set of strategy tools and guides for Japanese-speaking — and now English-speaking — players of the mobile strategy game Whiteout Survival. Our theme is beating alliance events like Bear Hunt and PvP (Foundry Battle, Castle Battle) by the numbers rather than by feel. Everything is made and maintained by hand by an active player (Jasmine), based on in-game testing and public information.

What is Bear Hunt in Whiteout Survival?

Bear Hunt is a recurring event where alliance members rally a giant bear together and compete on total damage. Final damage shifts hugely with who you set as rally leader (left), your troop ratio, exclusive gear and talents. It's easy to see "I added a strong hero but it didn't help" or big gaps between players with similar power — which is exactly why the right knowledge can multiply your result. Our tools estimate and visualize that variability so you can grow efficiently and avoid wasted spending or upgrades.

What you can do here (tools)

All free, no sign-up, and mobile-friendly. Pick what fits your goal.

  • Bear Hunt Damage Simulator … set heroes, troops, gear and talents to estimate one rally's damage. Great for A/B comparison.
  • Hero Database … search all 65 heroes by generation, class, rarity and skills. Favorites included.
  • Left-Hero Checker … instantly judge whether your left hero is effective when joining a rally.
  • Troop Ratio Simulator … compare 10:30:60 / 10:10:80 / 1:1:8 and more with your own counts.
  • Damage Doctor … answer a few questions to find why your damage is low.
  • Commander Type Quiz … 6 questions sort your Bear Hunt style into 6 types. Shareable on X.
  • Foundry Battle field tool … plan operations + run a mock battle to estimate capture points, and share.
  • Frost Dragon Placement Calculator … auto-assigns applicant alliances to host alliances so every host clears the entry border. Split orders by power included.
  • Castle Battle Area Planner … plan SvS server splits, alliance areas and city placement on a map and share.
